limits: Thread time is a diagnostic, never a substitute acceptance clock. The original wall-based ±1percent/10ms requirements and all failed rows remain.
Thread bracket starts before wall start and ends after wall end. Wall-minus-thread is a signed clock residual, not exact off-CPU duration; fixed timer edges/accounting effects remain.
CPU endpoints are only two observations. Same endpoints do not exclude migration; changed endpoints do not measure residency duration or identify performance/efficiency core type.
Process UTC starts/finishes include setup/warmup/postvalidation, not absolute timer-window timestamps. Equally spaced measurement centers cannot be reconstructed.

Seed repetition changes temporal half and size-order position. Post-hoc correlation, sign patterns and unbalanced endpoint groups are descriptive, with six blocks per size and no independent held-out diagnostic confirmation.
No clock/counter evidence distinguishes DVFS, cache/TLB/layout, contention, thermal behavior or other on-CPU causes. Low noise would also not establish lack of bias.
